tools.name: gil_search_city
tools.description: Search cities by name (prefix match) and get coordinates, country, hotel count and main airport. Returns lat/lng usable as input to the nearby tools. (도시 이름으로 좌표·국가·공항 검색)

tools.name: gil_hotels_nearby
tools.description: List hotels within a radius (max 20 km, max 20 results) of a coordinate, nearest first, with star rating, address and WIA Pin Code. No prices, review ratings, photos or booking links. Hotel facts come from WIA GIL's hotel database, which is built from partner (Agoda affiliate) data. (좌표 근처 호텔 목록, 가격

tools.name: gil_hotel_detail
tools.description: Get details of one hotel by hotel_id or WIA Pin Code (provide exactly one): address, star rating, check-in/out, number of rooms, year opened. No overview text, review ratings, photos, prices or booking links. (호텔 상세, 사진·가격·링크 제외)

tools.name: gil_places_nearby
tools.description: List landmarks or transport stops (stations etc.) within a radius (max 20 km) of a coordinate. Name fields may be in different languages; some places lack English names. (좌표 근처 명소·교통 시설)

tools.name: gil_country_travel_info
tools.description: Basic travel info for a country (ISO alpha-2): currency, voltage/plug, time zone, emergency numbers, entry/visa status for Republic of Korea passport holders, and the Korean embassy there. Includes a data_as_of date and disclaimer; may be out of date. (국가별 기본 여행 정보, 한국 여권 기준, 기준일 표시)

tools.name: gil_exchange_rates
tools.description: Reference exchange rates (cross rates computed from a USD table). Not a transaction rate. Defaults to 10 major currencies. (참고용 환율)

tools.name: gil_route_distance
tools.description: Approximate road/land route distance between two coordinates (straight-line limit 5,000 km). Returns distance and segments only; no travel time, no route geometry. (두 지점 간 대략적인 도로 거리)

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "gil_search_city" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
